message: Synchronous GPU readback is forbidden in Splatoon_C runtime code: Texture2D.ReadPixels and AsyncGPUReadbackRequest.WaitForCompletion stall the whole frame. Coverage scoring / ink sampling must use AsyncGPUReadback.Request on a downsampled target and consume the result asynchronously (see CLAUDE.md section 2). Editor-only tooling belongs under an Editor/ folder, which this rule does not cover. If the user explicitly approves a sync readback, add {"disable":["sc-sync-readback"]} to this pack.
